description: Step 2 («Цель»): four goals for the outreach to the people found (e.g. invite to a call), from the company description. The user picks or writes one. Part of a new search's onboarding: the first assistant call of an onboarding spends one brief (a free account has one search brief and may call each assistant once); pass the returned onboarding_id to the next calls and to create_search. [REST: POST /api/assist/goals]

onboarding_id.description: The onboarding id that ties the assistant calls and create_search into ONE brief. Omit it on the first call: the answer gives one; pass it to every later assistant call and to create_search of the same new search.

name: suggest_goals
title: Suggest outreach goals (onboarding step 2)
